name: Rapi: Red Hood
description:
Rapi, who has truly inherited the essence of Red Hood, equips herself with the weapon, Seven Dwarves Zero, which is engraved with their cherished promise.
She seeks to become the Goddess of Victory and reclaim the surface.

tierlist.name: Rapi: Red Hood
tierlist.cubeNotes: Resilience Cube when running a reload team. Otherwise Bastion Cube
tierlist.SkillPrioNotes:
Upgrade Skill 1 a level or two higher than Skill 2 if using her as a CDR, otherwise upgrade Skill 2 first

Skill 2 projectile damage is a major source of her damage. Upgrading it is necessary for optimal DPS

Burst massively boosts her projectile damage, which again, is a major source of her DPS when using her as a Burst III, this skill has lower priority if using her as a Burst I Nikke
tierlist.summary:
First dual element Nikke with rivaling DPS to SBS and Cinderella. Extremely flexible all-in-one Nikke that preferably wants to be Burst 3 but will still deal great DPS even as Burst 1. Excels in both Boss fights and campaign, being able to take on fire weak and iron weak stages with ease. Since Rapi has damage around the same tier as Scarlet: Black Shadow and Cinderella (SSS), beating out our current best MG DPS, Modernia.


(P.S. This is a DPS MG Nikke, they require 60 FPS to deal their expected damage. for reference, playing at 30 fps effectively halves their DPS)
